pages.en: Over the past couple of days, well,

pages.zh: 有一个十来个人规模的
pages.en: a business owner with around ten people
came to me for advice.

pages.zh: 问出了大多数老板的一个问题
pages.en: They asked a question most business owners have:
with companies adopting AI now,

pages.zh: 我们这种小公司还来得及吗
pages.en: is it still in time for a small company like ours?
Uh, how exactly should we do it?

pages.zh: 其实呢恰恰是这种小规模的公司
pages.en: Actually, it is precisely these small companies
that, compared with large enterprises,
can have greater advantages, uh,
and even stronger competitiveness.
The core reason is that small organizations
have organizational responsiveness built in.
Large enterprises have many management layers
and rigid processes.
When they want to roll out an AI transformation,
it means reporting up through layer after layer,
meeting after meeting,
and departments, well,
pulling against one another.

pages.zh: 等真真的方案讨论落地的时候
pages.en: By the time the plan is really, really discussed and implemented,
a lot of time is needed.

pages.zh: 但是咱们这个十几个人的公司就不一样了
pages.en: But a company like ours, with a dozen or so people, is different.
Once the boss makes the call,
the direction can be set that same day.
There is no complicated approval process,

pages.zh: 不需要协调好几个部门
pages.en: no need to coordinate several departments,
and the cost of trial and error is extremely low.

pages.zh: 我们不需要全员大改造
pages.en: We do not need to transform the whole workforce,

pages.zh: 啊也不需要全套的系统升级
pages.en: uh, or upgrade the entire system.

pages.zh: 只针对销售运营行政客服
pages.en: We focus on sales, operations, administration, customer service,

pages.zh: 剪辑文案这几个核心的岗位
pages.en: editing and copywriting—these core roles—
and then, well, implement AI specifically for them.

pages.zh: 只要把这几个岗位的AI流程打通啊
pages.en: Once AI workflows for these roles are connected, uh,
efficiency immediately doubles,
costs, well, immediately fall too,
and the results are instant.
If the AI tool feels useful,

pages.zh: 那么全员呢当天就能用上用上手啊
pages.en: then everyone, well, can use it, get the hang of it that same day, uh.

pages.zh: 如果说哪个流程跑不通的时候呢
pages.en: If a workflow does not work, well,
we immediately
adjust and iterate.

pages.zh: 这也是我现在在兰州最喜欢
pages.en: This is also why, here in Lanzhou, I most enjoy

pages.zh: 服务中小企业的核心原因
pages.en: serving small and medium-sized businesses.
Large enterprises, well,
have long delivery cycles,
and then major obstacles to implementation,
and especially serious internal friction.

pages.zh: 而咱们的本地的这个小微企业呢
pages.en: But our local small and micro businesses, well,
actually deliver fast and implement fast,
and produce results even faster.
The real value of AI, well,

pages.zh: 就是解决真实的业务问题
pages.en: is solving real business problems,
and then, well, improving business efficiency,
saving the boss money,
and increasing the team's income.
Many business owners, well,
are feeling anxious now.
Everyone else is using AI.
If I don't, well, I fear falling behind.

pages.zh: 做呢又不知道从哪里下手
pages.en: But if I do, I don't know where to start.
They install a pile of tools,
uh, and finally leave them all unused.
Nothing gets put to use. If, well,

pages.zh: 你也是在兰州本地的实体企业
pages.en: you also run a local real-economy business in Lanzhou,
a small or micro business, uh,
and you also cannot get AI into practice,
cannot get results,

pages.zh: 不知道怎么匹配自己业务
pages.en: or do not know how to match it to your business

pages.zh: 或者是行业的一些问题
pages.en: or face issues specific to your industry,
leave your industry in the comments.

pages.zh: 我来帮你免费拆解你的企业AI落地的方案
pages.en: I will help you work out, for free, your company's AI implementation plan.
If you want to talk face to face, uh,

pages.zh: 想要做本地的一对一的AI改造
pages.en: or want one-on-one AI transformation locally,

pages.zh: 也可以直接进我的粉丝群
pages.en: you can also join my fan group directly.
I'm Chao Ge,
rooted in Lanzhou.

pages.zh: 只做能落地有结果帮企业赚钱的AI实体应用
pages.en: I only work on practical, effective AI applications that help businesses make money through real-world use.
